name: Live Free Premium
description:
Your own wooded hideaway in the heart of New Hampshire. This shaded site is nestled among mature trees, offering privacy and that true back-to-nature feel. With full hookups including water, 30-amp electric, and sewer, plus easy back-in access, you get all the convenience without sacrificing the camping experience. Kick back under the canopy, enjoy the peace and quiet, and let the forest do the rest. 

Photos shown are representative of our wooded sites and may not reflect your exact site. To view a specific site, visit our virtual tour before booking. Please copy and paste this URL to visit, https://virtualtour.epsomvalleycampground.com.

name: Live Free Select
description:
Welcome to the safari zone — where the energy is contagious and the memories are made. These signature campsites are built for good times, whether you're rolling in with a group or flying solo. Surrounded by fellow campers with easy access to shared amenities, you'll feel the community spirit the moment you arrive. With water and 30-amp electric hookups, you've got the essentials covered so you can focus on what matters — making the most of every moment. 

Tent campers — give us a call to take advantage of special discounted pricing on this site! Tent discount rates are only available by phone and cannot be applied through online reservations.

name: Live Free Standard Tent
description:
Shaded beneath a canopy of mature trees, this tent site is what camping dreams are made of. Wake up to birdsong, sip your morning coffee surrounded by nature, and spend your days unwinding in your own peaceful wooded retreat. Each site comes equipped with a picnic table, fire ring, and easy access to bathhouse facilities, plus water and 20-amp electric hookups for added convenience.
